snippet.title: Violet Impetus Trailer
snippet.description:
wishlist now at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4289430/Violet_Impetus/

Violet Impetus is a short top-down arcade action melee 'em up (w optional scoring elements) developed by me! It's slated for release early Q2 this year (and I'm already 60% done with the content).

There's a slightly-outdated demo on itch (https://nanahyakuman.itch.io/violet-impetus-prototype), and a better demo will be out to itch and steam within the next month.

Enjoy!
